text: dsh-workflow-canvas 是面向 DSH 网页端的可视化工作流画布。用户可连接工具调用、子代理、条件及输出节点，编辑各节点字段，将图结构编译为步骤列表并导出 JSON。它适合希望图形化整理工作流的用户。通过 dsh plugin add @piedpiper911/dsh-workflow-canvas 安装；代码未显示额外密钥要求。Run 按钮目前只输出步骤到控制台。

dsh-workflow-canvas is a visual DSH web canvas for connecting tool, agent, condition, and output nodes. It edits node fields, compiles the graph into steps, and exports JSON. Install with dsh plugin add @piedpiper911/dsh-workflow-canvas. Run currently logs steps to the console.
想用图形画布把 DSH 的工具调用和代理步骤连成工作流。
我想给工作流加条件分支和结果输出节点。
能不能在网页里编辑每个流程节点的参数？
希望把画好的工作流结构导出成 JSON 文件。
I want to arrange tool calls and agent steps in a visual workflow canvas.
Can I add conditional and output nodes to a DSH workflow?
dsh-workflow-canvas 的功能「图形化编辑节点」：用户可在 React Flow 画布上连接节点，并编辑工具参数、代理提示词、条件表达式和输出模板。
dsh-workflow-canvas 的功能「编译工作流步骤」：画布把触发节点可达的图结构遍历为有序步骤，并将工具参数、代理提示词、条件表达式或输出模板写入对应步骤。
dsh-workflow-canvas 的功能「导出工作流文档」：点击 Export 会将当前名称、节点和连线序列化为 JSON，并触发浏览器下载。
dsh-workflow-canvas 使用前须知：Run 目前只把步骤写入控制台，不会调用工作流引擎执行（见 src/components/Toolbar.tsx:24-30）。
我想把子代理、工具和条件判断放进同一张工作流图里。
需要一个能把工作流图保存为 JSON 的 DSH 画布。

@piedpiper911/dsh-workflow-canvas README · dsh-workflow-canvas 🧭：Visual workflow builder for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH).
Drag and drop nodes to orchestrate **tool calls, sub-agents, and conditional branches** into a workflow that runs through DSH's `ctx.workflows` engine. Powered by [React Flow](https://github.com/xyflow/xyflow) (xyflow) and Zustand.

@piedpiper911/dsh-workflow-canvas README · Node types：| Node | What it does |
|---|---|
| ▶ Trigger | Workflow entry point (a prompt). |
| ⚙ Tool | A single tool call (e.g. `video_frames`, `bash`). |
| 🤖 Agent | Delegate a step to a sub-agent with its own prompt. |
| ◇ Condition | Branch on an expression (then/else edges). |
| ✓ Output | Terminal result template. |

@piedpiper911/dsh-workflow-canvas README · How it works：The data model is deliberately transport-agnostic: the canvas is a *view* over a plain-JSON workflow spec, so it composes with any DSH workflow provider.
